title: KCP hello result (DESIGN.md §11.1)
description: CommandResult.result payload for hello (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). The §11.1 HelloResult field list verbatim (gap note KG1).

features.description: Advertised feature bundles including transitive prerequisites (§11.6).

limits_digest.description: Typed digest of the installation's effective limits; the limits object and §11.8 construction remain a recorded K0 gap (spec/schemas/README.md item 4).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

displayName.description: Display name bounded by the §11.8 cap of 256 Unicode scalar values, length-bounded again at admission.

featureId.description: Feature-bundle name from the §11.6 table (e.g. core_v1). Bundles are atomic: implement every operation/schema/conformance case in a listed bundle or do not advertise it.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
